sequences.name: Welcome sequence
sequences.description: Starts when someone joins the list. Replace each note before anyone receives it.

steps.subject: You are on the list
steps.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

Thanks for signing up. Replace this note with the real next step for your offer before anyone receives it.

steps.subject: What happens after you opt in
steps.previewText: Replace this with something true about your offer
steps.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

This is a follow-up in the sequence. Replace it with a real detail about your offer before anyone receives it.

steps.subject: You are on the list
steps.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

Thanks for signing up. Replace this note with the real next step for your offer before anyone receives it.

sequences.name: Shopify Abandoned Cart & Checkout Recovery
sequences.description: Recovers shoppers who entered their details at checkout but dropped off before completing payment.

steps.subject: Your checkout is still open
steps.previewText: You can pick up where you left off
steps.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

You started a checkout and did not finish it. The items were not held aside.

You can return to the checkout here:
{{abandoned_checkout_url}}

steps.subject: Your checkout is still open
steps.previewText: You can pick up where you left off
steps.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

You started a checkout and did not finish it. The items were not held aside.

You can return to the checkout here:
{{abandoned_checkout_url}}
